effect_parts: Our backup first name is Iris.

We both like it—simple, natural, quiet elegance—but Elara is still our number one. My wife and I agree on that ranking. Iris is there in case something changes, like if we suddenly meet five other babies named Elara or something. It's just nice to have a fallback, you know?
